prerequisites: Hold TKPK Level 1 and Level 2 certificates and K3 licences
Minimum senior secondary education (SLTA) or equivalent, and minimum age 22
Documented rope access working experience (typically at least 1,000 hours)
Hold a workplace first aid (P3K) certificate
Final administrative requirements follow current Kemnaker rules — we check them with you on enrolment
outcomes: Write risk assessments and method statements for rope access work
Design anchor systems for complex conditions
Write and prove rescue plans on site
Lead and supervise TKPK Level 1 and 2 teams
Carry out internal inspections and keep project safety records

sections.body:
## Who this programme is for

This programme is for experienced TKPK Level 2 technicians who will carry full responsibility for a rope access worksite.

## Why a Kemnaker certificate

[Ministry of Manpower Regulation 9/2016](https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1210/peraturan-menteri-ketenagakerjaan-nomor-9-tahun-2016) requires work at height to be carried out by competent workers. The certificate and K3 licence issued by Indonesia’s Ministry of Manpower (Kemnaker RI) are nationally recognised proof of competence, checked by labour inspectors, contractors, and building managers alike. Read more about the [TKPK and TKBT schemes](/en/certification/).

## How we teach

Theory and practice run side by side: every topic is practised at height under instructor supervision and repeated until it is right. Training equipment is provided; trainees only need safety boots and work clothing.

items.q: How much does TKPK Level 3 training cost?
items.a: The cost of TKPK Level 3 depends on the number of participants, the location (open course or in-house), and your company’s needs. Send us your requirements on WhatsApp and we reply with a written quotation listing everything included.

items.q: How long is TKPK Level 3 training?
items.a: TKPK Level 3 duration and dates are confirmed on enrolment, following the syllabus and current Kemnaker competency test rules. Company courses can be scheduled on dates you choose.

items.q: What is tested for TKPK Level 3?
items.a: The competency test covers theory and practice: work-at-height regulation, equipment inspection, technique for the grade, and rescue. Successful candidates receive a competency certificate and K3 licence from Kemnaker RI.

items.q: What is a TKPK Level 3 holder responsible for?
items.a: A TKPK Level 3 holder plans rope access work, writes the risk assessment and rescue plan, leads Level 1 and 2 teams, and carries out internal inspections on site.

sections.title: Enrol or ask about the next course
sections.text: Send your name, the number of participants, and the month you are aiming for. For a group from one company, the course can run at your site.
